attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen Valley
attractions.description: Valley with towering cliffs and many waterfalls, good for a relaxed walk

attractions.name: Staubbach Falls
attractions.description: Waterfall cascading from nearly 300 metres in the Lauterbrunnen valley.

attractions.name: Trümmelbach Falls
attractions.description: Glacier-fed waterfalls thundering through tunnels inside the mountain
attractions.recommended_duration: Reached by ~10 min bus from Lauterbrunnen station

attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen Valley Path
attractions.description: Easy walk on a well-paved road with waterfalls spilling from the cliffs on both sides
tips: Walk as far as you like before returning; a few minutes in gives a view of Staubbach Falls
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide- Aayush and Sonal- Switzerland and Italy.docx

attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen Valley Path walk
attractions.description: Easy walk on a well paved road with waterfalls spilling from the cliffs on both sides; Staubbach Falls come into view a few minutes in
tips: Walk as far as you like before returning; not all the falls will be seen
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide- Switzerland and Paris(2).docx

attractions.name: Staubbach Falls viewpoint
attractions.description: Viewpoint for Staubbach Falls, the highest free-falling waterfall in Switzerland
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide- Switzerland and Paris(2).docx

attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen Valley Trail
attractions.description: Easy walk on a well-paved road with waterfalls on both sides and mountain peaks all around; walk as far as desired and return

attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen Village Walk
attractions.description: Postcard-perfect streets with chalets, cafés and grazing cows
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide Switzerland and Austria - Omkar(1).docx

attractions.name: Schilthornbahn Gondolas to Mürren
attractions.description: Local bus from Lauterbrunnen to Stechelberg, then gondolas via Gimmelwald to Mürren

attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen
attractions.description: Valley with towering cliffs and waterfalls cascading into green meadows.

attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen Village
attractions.description: Valley village with waterfalls, cliffs and traditional chalets.

transport_options.mode: Cable car and train to Mürren
transport_options.description: Cable car to Grütschalp (4 min) then train to Mürren BLM; ~20 min journey.
transport_options.covers: Included in the Swiss Travel Pass
transport_options._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide - Switzerland and Austria(1).docx

transport_options.description: Cable car from Lauterbrunnen to Grütschalp (4 mins), then train to Mürren BLM. Scenic return: cable car from Mürren to Stechelberg with a transfer at Gimmelwald, then bus to Lauterbrunnen (30–40 mins)

season_notes.tip: Trümmelbach Falls is open May to October
